media.unavailableTitle: This video is no longer available
media.unavailableBody: The media for this older upload couldn't be found. The post still exists on Hive.
media.scheduledBody: It will be published on {{date}}. The video can be watched from then on.
media.blockedTitle: Couldn't load the video right now

scheduled.editTitle: Edit scheduled post (details, date, or cancel)

actions.voteOffChain: Vote on this video. It is saved on 3Speak and pays no rewards.

edit.title: Edit Video
edit.replaceHint: Swaps the video file on this post. Everything else stays as it is: the post keeps its likes, payout, comments, upload date and its place in your profile. Leave this alone to keep the current video.
edit.uploadedTo: Uploaded to {{host}}. Press Save to swap it in.
edit.uploaded: Uploaded. Press Save to swap it in.
edit.encodeHint: After you save it still needs a few minutes to encode, and the old video keeps playing until it is ready. Your thumbnail is unchanged, so update it above if it no longer matches.
edit.thumbHint: Upload an image or paste a direct URL. Leave unchanged to keep the current thumbnail.
edit.listedHint: Shown in feeds, search and on your profile.
edit.unlistedHint: Hidden from feeds & search — still plays by direct link, stays on your profile (badged).
edit.remixOn: Others can create remixes/clips; you are credited as original author.
edit.remixOff: Others cannot remix or clip this video.
edit.adsOnHint: Ads may play on this video.
edit.rollsOnHint: Rolls, banners and tickers may show.
edit.rollsOffHint: Only banners and tickers on this video.
edit.trailerOn: Autoplays at the top of your profile’s Overview tab, replacing any trailer you set before.
edit.trailerOff: Make this the video that autoplays at the top of your profile’s Overview tab.
edit.nsfwHint: Hidden from feeds & search unless the viewer enabled NSFW; tagged nsfw on Hive.
edit.videoUploaded: New video uploaded. Save to apply it to this post.
edit.updatedEncoding: Video updated! The new file needs a few moments to finish encoding.

errors.notFound: Could not find this post on Hive.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load post from Hive. Please try again.
errors.noVideoEntry: This post has no video entry to replace — its metadata doesn't reference one.
errors.notInLibrary: This post's video is no longer in the library, so its file can't be replaced.
errors.notOwner: You can only replace the file on your own video.
errors.noEmbedEntry: This post has no embed video entry to replace — its metadata doesn't reference one.
errors.trailerFailed: Could not update your channel trailer.
errors.adsSyncFailed: Saved, but the ad setting for this video has not reached 3Speak yet. Try saving again.

edit.timelineHint: Chapters show on the progress bar, links pop up at the top right of the video. The preview plays the published video.
edit.chaptersNoteAll: The chapter list is written into the description when you save.
edit.fixErrors: Please fix the marked tab first.
